info.name: Gazebo - Stock Downtime
info.description:
Record Downtime floor API (legacy parity).

**Table:** `stock_entry` (`entry_type=downtime`) + `production_run` sidecar.

Qty is always 0; stock_balance is not updated.

**Vars:** `{{base_url}}`, `{{idempotency_key}}`, `{{product_id}}`, `{{location_id}}`, `{{resource_id}}`

request.description:
### List downtime types

`GET /stock/downtime/`

Returns active pseudo-products flagged `is_downtime=true` for the Record Downtime picker (BREAK, BREAKDOWN, CLEANING, …).

**Path parameters**

None.

**Query parameters**

None.

**Request body**

**None**.

**Response body**

`{ status, message: "Downtime types fetched.", data: [ { id, name, unit_id, unit_name }, ... ] }`

**Status codes**

| Code | When |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | Success |

### Record downtime

`POST /stock/downtime/`

Writes a zero-qty ledger row (`entry_type=downtime`) plus `production_run` timing sidecar. Does **not** project `stock_balance`. Product must have `is_downtime=true` (use GET for picker). Same floor fields as Production Data minus quantity.

**Path parameters**

None.

**Query parameters**

None.

**Request body**

| Field | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `idempotency_key` | yes | Safe retries |
| `product_id` | yes* | Downtime type (*or `lot_id`) |
| `lot_id` | yes* | Existing lot (*or `product_id`) |
| `location_id` | yes | Process department |
| `resource_id` | yes | Line / resource |
| `started_at` | yes | ISO-8601 start |
| `finished_at` | yes | ISO-8601 end (must be after start) |
| `base_date` | no | Defaults to today |
| `shift_code` | no | e.g. AM/PM |
| `staff_count` | no | Headcount |
| `unit_id` | no | Defaults to product stock unit |
| `remarks` | no | Free text |

**Response body**

`{ status, message: "Downtime recorded.", data: { entry, run } }` — `entry.quantity` is `"0.000000"`, `entry.entry_type` is `downtime`.

**Status codes**

| Code | When |
| --- | --- |
| 201 | Created (or idempotent replay) |
| 400 | Validation (not downtime product, missing times, inactive resource, no open period) |
